decisions.reason: As a prominently announced new product line close to the core software business and the firm's digital-practice direction, it has high visible commitment and sunk development effort, so management is likely to persist with it.

Although less publicly emphasized, the education institute builds on the firm's training and practitioner-support capabilities, so a growing, innovative firm is likely to retain it rather than quickly reverse course.
The remote support tool fits the established support offering and can be justified as a practical add-on for customers, making continued commitment more likely than withdrawal after a short time.
